name: batch_delete_block_property
firstLine: Remove property values from many blocks in one call; prefer it to repeated single deletes.

name: batch_insert_block_trees
firstLine: Build or fill several pages in one call, creating missing ones; best for multi-page writes.

name: batch_move_blocks
firstLine: Move many blocks to different places in one call; move_blocks suits a single destination.

name: batch_set_block_property
firstLine: Set tags and properties on many blocks or pages in one call; prefer it for more than one value.

name: capture_to_today
firstLine: Append notes to today's journal; use insert_block_tree for any other page or day.

name: connector_help
firstLine: The connector's writing rules: read once before the first write in a conversation.

name: create_page
firstLine: Create a page by title; a title already in use is refused, naming the existing page.

name: create_property
firstLine: Define a new property with its type, choices or classes; check list_properties first.

name: create_tag
firstLine: Create a tag (class) with what it extends and its properties; check list_tags first.

name: create_task
firstLine: Create a task with status, priority and dates; use it for every action item, never TODO text.

name: datalog_query
firstLine: Read-only Datalog for questions no other tool answers; try run_named_query first.

name: delete_block
firstLine: Delete one block and its children; use delete_blocks for several.

name: delete_block_property
firstLine: Remove one property value from a block or page.

name: delete_blocks
firstLine: Delete up to 100 blocks in one call; dry-run first and show the user what goes.

name: delete_page
firstLine: Move a page and its blocks to the Recycle bin; dry-run first to see its references.

name: delete_property
firstLine: Delete a property definition and its values; dry-run first to see what is lost.

name: delete_tag
firstLine: Delete a tag, which its holders lose; dry-run first to see the counts.

name: get_activity_log
firstLine: What the connector changed in a graph, newest first: the answer to 'what did you change?'

name: get_block
firstLine: One block or page by UUID with its tags and properties, without its children.

name: get_blocks
firstLine: Up to 100 blocks or pages by UUID in one call, optionally with their outlines.

name: get_graph_health
firstLine: Tidy-up report: unused tags and properties, duplicates, page gaps, broken refs, missing tag values.

name: get_page
firstLine: One page's tags and properties by UUID, title or date; get_page_outline reads its content.

name: get_page_backlinks
firstLine: How a page is used: links, tagged objects and property values pointing at it, with counts.

name: get_page_outline
firstLine: Read a whole page as markdown with tags, properties and links resolved; the usual way to read.

name: get_property
firstLine: A property's type, choices and classes; check it before setting a choice or node value.

name: get_tag
firstLine: A tag's properties, the tags it extends and the tags that extend it.

name: insert_block_children
firstLine: Add block trees under an existing block; insert_block_tree also takes a page as target.

name: insert_block_tree
firstLine: Write a whole note as one nested block tree on a page or under a block; the usual way to write.

name: kb_index
firstLine: Start here for broad questions: every page grouped by class, with its summary and UUID.

name: list_assets
firstLine: The graph's files and images, with the asset UUIDs read_file takes.

name: list_favorites
firstLine: The pages in the sidebar's Favorites list, in order.

name: list_graphs
firstLine: Call first: the connected graphs and the alias every other tool's graph argument takes.

name: list_page_blocks
firstLine: A page's top-level blocks, paginated; get_page_outline reads the whole tree at once.

name: list_page_references
firstLine: Blocks and pages that link to a page, paginated; get_page_backlinks gives grouped counts.

name: list_pages
firstLine: All pages, paginated, filterable by created or updated date; kb_index suits an overview.

name: list_properties
firstLine: Every property with its type; check here before creating a property.

name: list_tag_objects
firstLine: Every page or block with a given tag, paginated, such as all Person pages.

name: list_tags
firstLine: Every tag in the graph; check here before creating or applying a tag.

name: list_tasks
firstLine: Tasks filtered by status, priority or text: the way to answer what is outstanding.

name: move_blocks
firstLine: Move blocks under or beside a block or page; dry-run a large move first.

name: promote_page_to_tag
firstLine: Turn an existing page into a tag, keeping its blocks and references.

name: read_file
firstLine: Read a saved asset back by its UUID: text as text, images as images.

name: refresh_refs
firstLine: Re-apply link and tag handling to blocks written before it existed; dry-run unless applied.

name: reorder_favorites
firstLine: Set the order of the sidebar favourites; pass the full list from list_favorites.

name: run_named_query
firstLine: Four ready-made questions: stale projects, undecided meetings, open tasks, pages missing a value.

name: save_document
firstLine: Save text or a base64 file into the graph as an asset, linked from a page or the journal.

name: save_file_from_url
firstLine: Download a public https file into the graph as an asset, linked from a page or the journal.

name: search_graph
firstLine: Find pages, blocks, tags and properties by the exact words in their titles and text.

name: semantic_index_status
firstLine: How much of a graph the meaning-based search index covers.

name: semantic_search
firstLine: Find blocks by meaning as well as title words; use it when the exact words may differ.

name: set_block_property
firstLine: Set one tag or property on a block or page; batch_set_block_property sets several.

name: set_page_favorite
firstLine: Add a page to the sidebar favourites, or remove it.

name: suggest_links
firstLine: Before writing notes, find the words that should link to existing pages; never writes.

name: update_block
firstLine: Replace one block's text or display type; set_block_property changes its properties.

name: update_page
firstLine: Rename a page; set_block_property changes its tags and properties.

name: update_property
firstLine: Change a property's title, choices or classes, or convert its text values to choices.

name: update_tag
firstLine: Change a tag's title, the tags it extends or its properties.
